TitleCard.description: Headline whose words rise out of a mask; one accent word in italic serif.

BigStat.description: A big number that counts up with a label.

Typewriter.description: Text typed letter by letter with a blinking cursor.

Stamp.description: A verdict stamp that slams in (VERIFIED, WRONG, NOT A GUARANTEE).

Highlight.description: A sentence where one word gets a hand-drawn marker (rough-notation).

KineticList.description: Items that pop in one by one.

BrowserWindow.description: A browser window that swings in with a REAL screenshot (or a skeleton). Optional slow zoom to a spot.

Terminal.description: Dark terminal that types commands; lines starting with > are output.

PhoneFrame.description: A phone showing a post or a screenshot, likes count up.

ChatBubbles.description: A chat conversation; bubbles appear in turn.

NotebookPage.description: Ruled notebook page with an italic title and bullets (calm explainer look).

CommentBox.description: The 'Comment WORD' call to action: types the keyword, flips to Posted, shows the reward line.

props.typeAnchor: word on which the keyword is typed (the box is visible from the cut)

BarChart.description: Bars that grow with values counting up; one highlighted.

LineChart.description: A line that draws itself with a final value counter.

Checklist.description: Items that tick off one by one.

props.heading: string, e.g. 'CLAUDE IS BUILDING'
props.progress: true = a progress bar fills as items tick

Versus.description: Two things face to face with a VS badge.

RouteMap.description: Parchment map with a route that draws itself and labelled stops.

ProofCard.description: REAL proof: a captured screenshot, slow zoom to the key region, hand-drawn circle, source named.

EvidenceCard.description: A case file, polaroid or ticket with title, lines, redacted words and a stamp.

Scene3D.description: LEGACY (R3F, primitive characters). Kept so old projects still render; new work uses Stage3D.

props.wall: true = a screen wall of charts behind the studio set

FileList.description: Folder listing with one row selected (yellow outline) or an empty rename box.

props.title: 'FILES'
props.input: true = the selected row is an empty rename box

Ledger.description: A price list with lines struck through one by one and a total (what I pay for).

ProfileCard.description: A creator profile with a video grid, one tile highlighted and a sticker badge (9M VIEWS). Use real numbers only.

RepoCard.description: A GitHub repository page with the star count circled in red. Capture the real page when possible (ProofCard); use this when a clean redrawn page reads better.

props.anchor: word when the circle is drawn

EndCard.description: Closing card: serif headline with an accent word, a call-to-action pill and a handle, on a soft gradient.

Stage3D.description: A directed 3D shot with the film-look engine (soft shadows, depth of field, bloom). Characters are sculpted/rigged (kind human|critter|blocky|stick), the world is a named environment, and the camera is a motivated cinematography spec.

HtmlBlock.description: Plays a HyperFrames-style HTML block (HTML + CSS + paused GSAP timeline on window.__timelines) seeked by the Remotion frame: ONE clock. Use for ready-made registry blocks (lower thirds, kinetic type, transitions) where they beat rebuilding them.

props.vars: {key: value}: given to the block as window.__hfVariables (HyperFrames contract) and as {{key}} text replacements
props.at: seconds into the shot when it starts
props.fit: 'contain' (default: whole block visible) or 'cover' (fills the 9:16 frame, crops a 16:9 block)
props.replace: [[from, to], ...]: exact text replacements in the block's source (blocks configured by a literal CONFIG object, e.g. mk-progress-stat: [['value: 22,','value: 20,']]). A missing 'from' text fails loudly.

FlowDiagram.description: A vertical flow of steps animated with GSAP (seeked by the Remotion frame): each step pops on its spoken word, the arrow draws just before.

RemocnBlock.description: One component from the remocn registry (350+ animations, backgrounds, transitions, app-screen simulations, captions). Install it first with tools/remocn.mjs; it runs on our timeline.

props.name: remocn component name, e.g. 'claude-code' (required, must be installed)
props.props: the component's own props (see `node tools/remocn.mjs info <name>`)
props.at: seconds into the shot when it starts, 0
props.scale: 1; about 1.1 makes a 16:9 app window fill a 9:16 frame (1.2 clips the edges)
props.dy: px to move it up (negative) or down

PlateShot.description: A photoreal PLATE (path-traced in Blender, renderers/blender) with a real camera move: depth-driven parallax push, pull, truck, crane, orbit. Fast and film-like; for moves up to about 8 degrees or 12 percent push.

props.depth: public path of its depth map (required)

Footage.description: A real clip: a Playwright screen recording of a real site, a Blender sequence or footage you own, muted, with an optional browser window, slow zoom and a source line.

props.source: small line: what it is and where from

InkShot.description: A shot drawn by the inkbeat 3D toon engine (renderers/inkbeat, see ink-plan.json): same storyboard, gates, voice, captions timing, critics and QA as every other shot. Only valid in packs with engine inkbeat.

RadialMenu.description: An options wheel (weapon wheel, mode picker): 3 to 8 sectors that light one by one on their spoken words, a hub label. Turns a spoken LIST of options into one picture.

Devices.description: Two to four labelled phones side by side (where it is posted, where it runs); each pops in on its spoken word.

StickScene.description: 2D sketchy stickman scene: a painted set (kitchen, station, street), 1-3 characters with face sprites, wide or punch-in camera, optional speech bubble and yellow title bar.

props.cast: array of {id, x 0-1, mood, pose, shirt, hair, seated, flip, scale}
props.camera: {zoom, on (character id to frame), focus [x,y] 0-1, at [x,y] where the focus lands on screen, push per second}
props.speaker: id of the character whose mouth moves

FaceCam.description: Face-cam layout: your clip (or a placeholder) on a rounded face sheet with a bordered overlay card and a section chip above it; modes split, card, face.

caption_presets: headline (top-left, grey until spoken, red italic accent: editorial)
dialogue (top pill with speaker tag: 3D story)
caps-plate (small UPPERCASE words on a dark rounded plate: neon-stage look)
effects: style.json 'effects': {grain, vignette, bokeh, rain, halftone, paper}

shot_fields.bg: background colour for this shot: 'paper' | a name from style.json bgs (dark, slate, green, red ...) | a hex
shot_fields.presenter: {pose, mood, hidden}: the illustrated host's gesture for this shot (editorial packs with a presenter). poses: idle point open wave think shrug; moods: calm happy surprised worried smirk
shot_fields.speaker: name shown as a tag above dialogue captions
shot_fields.overlays: graphics on top of the main component, see overlays

overlays.label: {left, right, rightAccent}: mono HUD row at the top ('// 03 · step one' ... 'LAYERS 2/4')
overlays.step-chip: {n, of, x, y, anchor}: black numbered square with progress dots
overlays.dial: {label, sub, from, to, color, x, y, anchor}: speed/level gauge, needle sweeps from `from` to `to` (0..1) on the word; label is the big text ('10x'), sub the small caps ('SPEED')
overlays.hud: {label, value, valueTo, changeAt, caption, x, y}: series HUD top-left, red dot + label ('DAYS LEFT'), big value that flicks to valueTo, small caption ('PLAYERS ALIVE')
overlays.hub: {text, items:[{label, anchor|at}], r, x, y, color}: centre circle with spokes that draw one by one, one item per spoken word
overlays.step-card: {chip, title, lines[], progress, x, y, color}: white window card with a STEP chip, a title, mono lines and a progress bar
overlays.device-list: {rows:[{label, tag, tone good|bad|neutral, anchor|at}], x, y}: list card whose tags (Yours / Not recognized / Blocked) land one row at a time
overlays.step-label: {text, n, of, y, anchor}: dark pill 'STEP 2 · ONE FOLDER' with yellow dashes (top centre)
overlays.sticker: {text, color, rotate, x, y, size, anchor}: tilted outlined label ('9M VIEWS')
overlays.tags: {items:[{text,color}], x, y, anchor}: pills with dots ('free', 'open source')
overlays.callout: {text, x, y, rotate, anchor}: white speech label
overlays.cursor: {from:[x,y], to:[x,y], dur, anchor}: arrow cursor with motion lines, then a click ripple
overlays.scribble: {kind:'circle'|'underline'|'highlight'|'box'|'strike'|'crossed'|'bracket', x, y, w, h, color, anchor}: hand-drawn annotation around a region (official @remotion/rough-notation)
overlays.hearts: {x, y, count, anchor}: hearts floating up
overlays.waveform: {x, y, bars, color}: audio bars that move with the voice
overlays.warning: {text, x, y, anchor}: yellow-bordered warning bar
overlays.progress: {name, to, w, x, y, dur, anchor}: file progress card
overlays.backword: {text, color, y, size}: huge glowing word behind everything
overlays.plaque: headline plaque at the top: text (2-5 words), texts [{anchor|at, text}] to change the plaque inside one shot, kicker (small line), y (px, 170), size (52), caps (true), border
overlays.counter: a number that counts up in a dark box: from, to, dur (1.6 s), prefix, suffix, label, y (px), size (76), color; starts on its anchor
overlays.bubble: a character's emoji thought bubble: emoji, text (1-3 words), x, y (px), size; pops on its anchor
overlays.burst: neon streaks that punctuate ONE impact word: x, y (px), color, count (14); on its anchor
overlays.impact: {text, x, y (px), size (220), rotate (-6), color, shadow, anchor}: a giant outlined word that slams in with a shake on its anchor (KILLED, FREE, #1)
overlays.remocn: {name, props, scale (0.7), x, y (px shift), anchor|at}: a remocn component floating over the 3D stage so the characters stay in frame

focus-ring.description: A pulsing ring that says 'look here' on a point (the reference reels put one on every object the narrator is about to name).

verdict.description: A full-width verdict banner: PASSED/POSTED/DONE in green, or FAILED/FLOPPED with a shake and a RETRY button. Use for the problem in the hook and the result at the end (the skin gives the words).

price-tag.description: A tag that hangs from a point and swings: $0 FREE, or a price. Put it on the thing that is free or costs something.

rain.description: Bills, coins or confetti falling over the whole frame on a word (thousands of dollars, a win).

prop.description: A picture of a thing or idea (Noto emoji) as a sticker-prop with a short animation. The universal overlay for an unusual idea: a brain for memory, a roadblock for a bottleneck, a stack of coins for cost.

overlays.doodle: {shape:'arrow'|'check'|'sparks'|'bulb'|'rocket'|'gear'|'code'|'chart'|'clock'|'lock', x, y, size, rotate, color, strokeWidth, dur, anchor}: a hand-drawn picture that draws itself on the spoken word. For circle, underline, box, strike use scribble.
